name: io.github.mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server
description: MongoDB Model Context Protocol Server

setup.name: MDB_MCP_ALLOW_REQUEST_OVERRIDES
setup.description: When set to true, allows configuration values to be overridden via request headers and query parameters.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID
setup.description: Atlas API client ID for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET
setup.description: Atlas API client secret for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL
setup.description: Base URL for the MongoDB Assistant API.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_ATLAS_TEMPORARY_DATABASE_USER_LIFETIME_MS
setup.description: Time in milliseconds that temporary database users created when connecting to MongoDB Atlas clusters will remain active before being automatically deleted.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
setup.description: Comma separated values of tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Requires the client to support elicitation.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING
setup.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections. Optional, if not set, you'll need to call the connect tool before interacting with MongoDB data.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_JS
setup.description: When set to true, disallows the use of server-side JavaScript operators (such as $where, $function, and $accumulator) in query filters and aggregation pipelines.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
setup.description: Comma separated values of tool names, operation types, and/or categories of tools that will be disabled.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_DRY_RUN
setup.description: When true, runs the server in dry mode: dumps configuration and enabled tools, then exits without starting the server.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
setup.description: Time in milliseconds between export cleanup cycles that remove expired export files.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS
setup.description: Time in milliseconds after which an export is considered expired and eligible for cleanup.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORTS_PATH
setup.description: Folder to store exported data files.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_EXTERNALLY_MANAGED_SESSIONS
setup.description: When true, the HTTP transport allows requests with a session ID supplied externally through the 'mcp-session-id' header. When an external ID is supplied, the initialization request is optional.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_HOST
setup.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerHost` instead. Host address to bind the healthCheck HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckPort` must also be set.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
setup.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerPort` instead. Port number for the healthCheck HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckHost` must also be set.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_BODY_LIMIT
setup.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request body in bytes (only used when transport is 'http'). This value is passed as the optional limit parameter to the Express.js json() middleware.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HEADERS
setup.description: Header that the HTTP server will validate when making requests (only used when transport is 'http').

setup.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST
setup.description: Host address to bind the HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http').

setup.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_PORT
setup.description: Port number for the HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). Use 0 for a random port.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_TYPE
setup.description: The HTTP response type for tool responses: 'sse' for Server-Sent Events, 'json' for standard JSON responses.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
setup.description: Idle timeout for a client to disconnect (only applies to http transport).

setup.name: MDB_MCP_INDEX_CHECK
setup.description: When set to true, enforces that query operations must use an index, rejecting queries that perform a collection scan.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_LOG_PATH
setup.description: Folder to store logs.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_LOGGERS
setup.description: Comma separated values of logger types.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_BYTES_PER_QUERY
setup.description: The maximum size in bytes for results from a find or aggregate tool call. This serves as an upper bound for the responseBytesLimit parameter in those tools.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_QUERY
setup.description: The maximum number of documents that can be returned by a find or aggregate tool call. For the find tool, the effective limit will be the smaller of this value and the tool's limit parameter.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_TIME_M_S
setup.description: The maximum time in milliseconds that operations are allowed to run on the MongoDB server. When set, this value is passed as the maxTimeMS option to read operations such as find, aggregate, and count.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_MCP_CLIENT_LOG_LEVEL
setup.description: Minimum severity level for log messages forwarded to the MCP client.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_FEATURES
setup.description: Features to expose on the monitoring server (only used when transport is 'http' and monitoringServerHost/monitoringServerPort are set).

setup.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_HOST
setup.description: Host address to bind the monitoring HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerPort` must also be set.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_PORT
setup.description: Port number for the monitoring HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerHost` must also be set.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_NOTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_MS
setup.description: Notification timeout for a client to be aware of disconnect (only applies to http transport).

setup.name: MDB_MCP_PREVIEW_FEATURES
setup.description: Comma separated values of preview features that are enabled.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY
setup.description: When set to true, only allows read, connect, and metadata operation types, disabling create/update/delete operations.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_TELEMETRY
setup.description: When set to disabled, disables telemetry collection.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT
setup.description: Either 'stdio' or 'http'.

setup.name: MDB_MCP_VOYAGE_API_KEY
setup.description: API key for Voyage AI embeddings service (required for creating Atlas Local deployments with auto-embed vector search capabilities).

title: MongoDB

name: io.github.cyanheads/obsidian-mcp-server
description: Read, write, search, and surgically edit Obsidian notes, tags, and frontmatter via MCP.

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_API_KEY
setup.description: Bearer token for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (Settings → Community Plugins → Local REST API).

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL
setup.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable "Non-encrypted (HTTP) Server" in plugin settings). Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the always-on HTTPS port (self-signed cert; pair with OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL=false).

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL
setup.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate on the Obsidian endpoint. Default false because the plugin uses a self-signed cert.

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
setup.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS
setup.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS
setup.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; trailing slashes normalized. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS
setup.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
setup.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

setup.name: OBSIDIAN_OMNISEARCH_URL
setup.description: Override URL for the Omnisearch plugin HTTP server. Unset derives from OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL host with port 51361. Required only if the Omnisearch plugin is not on the default port.

setup.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
setup.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

setup.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
setup.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

setup.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
setup.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

setup.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
setup.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

setup.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
setup.description: Authentication mode to use: 'none', 'jwt', or 'oauth'.

title: Obsidian
